joint_sections.method: section area of the final field on the plane through each member at the node body radius (disk 1.5 a) over the incident member section pi a b; below_one counts ratios < 0.95 (sampling at h/2)

load_paths.method: material eroded by r (EDT > r) labelled with 26-connectivity; a mount is carried when the largest core component reaches into the mount region padded by r + h; r = 0.9 mm stands for the 2 mm minimum section
